components.name: Chart
components.description: All chart types use the Chart namespace:

props.name: innerRadius
props.description: Override donut inner radius (default auto by variant)

notes: **⚠️ chartConfig is REQUIRED.** It maps data keys to labels and colors.
examples:
import { Chart, ChartArea, ChartBar, ChartLegend, ChartLegendContent, ChartLine, ChartPie, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent, ChartXAxis, ChartYAxis } from '@7onic-ui/react/chart'

const chartConfig = {
  revenue: { label: 'Revenue', color: 'var(--color-chart-1)' },
  profit: { label: 'Profit', color: 'var(--color-chart-2)' },
}

{/* Line Chart */}
<Chart config={chartConfig} className="h-[300px]">
  <ChartXAxis dataKey="month" />
  <ChartYAxis />
  <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
  <ChartLegend content={<ChartLegendContent />} />
  <ChartLine dataKey="revenue" type="monotone" />
  <ChartLine dataKey="profit" type="monotone" variant="dashed" />
</Chart>

{/* Bar Chart */}
<Chart config={chartConfig} className="h-[300px]" hoverFade>
  <ChartXAxis dataKey="month" />
  <ChartYAxis />
  <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
  <ChartBar dataKey="revenue" radius="md" />
  <ChartBar dataKey="profit" radius="md" />
</Chart>

{/* Area Chart */}
<Chart config={chartConfig} className="h-[300px]">
  <ChartXAxis dataKey="month" />
  <ChartYAxis />
  <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
  <ChartArea dataKey="revenue" type="monotone" variant="gradient" />
</Chart>

{/* Pie Chart */}
<Chart config={chartConfig} className="h-[300px]">
  <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
  <ChartPie data={data} dataKey="value" nameKey="name" variant="donut" label="outside" />
</Chart>

components.name: ChatInput

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius (`'full'` available in inline layout)

props.name: layout
props.description: `'inline'` renders field and button side by side

props.name: loading
props.description: Switch to stop icon — button stays enabled

props.name: buttonRadius
props.description: Override button radius (default: auto from container radius)

examples:
import { ChatInput, ChatInputField, ChatInputSubmit } from '@7onic-ui/react'

{/* Basic uncontrolled */}
<ChatInput onSubmit={(value) => console.log(value)}>
  <ChatInputField placeholder="Ask me anything..." />
  <ChatInputSubmit />
</ChatInput>

{/* Controlled mode */}
const [value, setValue] = useState('')
<ChatInput onSubmit={(v) => { handleSend(v); setValue('') }}>
  <ChatInputField
    value={value}
    onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
    placeholder="Ask me anything..."
  />
  <ChatInputSubmit />
</ChatInput>

{/* With loading state + stop */}
<ChatInput onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
  <ChatInputField placeholder="Ask me anything..." />
  <ChatInputSubmit
    loading={isLoading}
    onStop={() => abortController.abort()}
  />
</ChatInput>

{/* Character count */}
<ChatInput onSubmit={(value) => console.log(value)}>
  <ChatInputField placeholder="Ask me anything..." showCount maxLength={500} />
  <ChatInputSubmit />
</ChatInput>

{/* Filled variant, large, custom radius */}
<ChatInput variant="filled" size="lg" radius="2xl" onSubmit={(v) => console.log(v)}>
  <ChatInputField placeholder="Ask me anything..." maxRows={6} />
  <ChatInputSubmit />
</ChatInput>

{/* Inline layout (single-line field + button side by side) */}
<ChatInput layout="inline" radius="full" onSubmit={(value) => console.log(value)}>
  <ChatInputField placeholder="Message..." />
  <ChatInputSubmit />
</ChatInput>

{/* Inline with custom button radius */}
<ChatInput layout="inline" radius="xl" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
  <ChatInputField placeholder="Message..." />
  <ChatInputSubmit buttonRadius="full" loading={isLoading} onStop={handleStop} />
</ChatInput>
